subject.title: fix(reef): bound relay HTTP JSON response body reads

question: Does the Reef relay contract guarantee that every valid success response, especially mailbox pulls, remains below the proposed 16 MiB client ceiling?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish memory safety, but neither the public Reef documentation nor the PR evidence establishes the maximum legitimate relay response size, so automation cannot safely decide the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Confirm contract and merge
options.body: Confirm that relay responses are paged or bounded below 16 MiB, refresh the branch, and merge the shared-reader implementation.

options.title: Use an endpoint-derived ceiling
options.body: Replace the generic success limit with a value derived from documented Reef envelope, batch, and page limits, then test the largest valid mailbox response.

options.title: Pause pending protocol limits
options.body: Hold the PR until the relay protocol defines a maximum success response size so the client does not create an accidental compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm that relay responses are paged or bounded below 16 MiB, refresh the branch, and merge the shared-reader implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a bundled-channel compatibility and availability decision, and steipete is the best available repository-level decision owner from the inspected ownership metadata.
